description: Tag selection component displaying selected tags as colored chips with a dropdown for adding more. Supports inline search with filtering, optional inline tag creation via OnCreateTag callback, and disabled state.

parameters.name: AllTags
parameters.description: All tags available for selection. The dropdown filters this list against already-selected tags and the current search text.

parameters.name: SelectedTags
parameters.description: Currently selected tags, rendered as colored chips.

parameters.name: OnTagsChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the selection changes (tag added or removed), passing the full updated list. The caller is responsible for updating SelectedTags.

parameters.name: AllowCreate
parameters.description: When true, shows a search input and a 'Vytvořit' option at the bottom of the dropdown whenever the typed name does not already exist in AllTags. Requires OnCreateTag to be wired up to actually persist the new tag.

parameters.name: OnCreateTag
parameters.description: Fires when the user clicks the inline 'Vytvořit' option, passing the typed tag name. The callback is responsible for creating the tag, adding it to AllTags, and optionally pre-selecting it. Used only when AllowCreate="true".

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables all interaction — hides the trigger button and chip remove buttons.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class appended to the root element.

interfaces.name: ITag
interfaces.description: Represents a single tag. Implement this interface on your domain/DTO class to use it with TmTagPicker.

members.name: Id
members.description: Unique identifier used to compare tags and avoid duplicates.

members.name: Name
members.description: Display name shown in the chip and dropdown option.

members.name: Color
members.description: CSS color value for the tag badge, e.g. "#3b82f6" or "var(--tm-color-primary)".

examples.title: Tag picker with inline creation — complete page example
examples.description: Full example showing ITag implementation, state management, and OnCreateTag handler that creates and immediately selects the new tag.
